patches.title: Transformation Without Interruption
patches.principle: After picking up an object that needs transformation, go directly to the appliance, transform it, then go directly to the destination and place. No detours or extra actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that requires cleaning, heating, or cooling before placement.

patches.title: Open Destination On Arrival
patches.principle: When carrying an object to a closed container destination, open it immediately upon arrival before attempting to place the object inside.
patches.when_to_apply: When arriving at a closed container that is the task destination and you are holding the object.

patches.title: Avoid Container Search First
patches.principle: When looking for an object to clean, first check all open surfaces (countertops, dining tables) before opening any closed containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object for cleaning is not visible and closed containers exist.
